sources.name: CLOB market info
facts: mos is minimum order size
mts is minimum tick size
fd contains fee-curve parameters
itode indicates taker order delay
oas is minimum order age

sources.name: Place Orders
facts: limit-order size must meet minimum order size
price must conform to current tick size
size is rounded down to two decimals
amount precision depends on tick size
tick_size_change events invalidate cached tick size
post-only marketable orders are rejected rather than taking liquidity

sources.name: Fees
facts: platform fees are taker-only
makers pay zero platform fees
published fee formula is C * feeRate * p * (1-p)
sports reference feeRate on observation date is 0.05
taker fees are rounded to five decimal places

sources.name: Maker Rebates
facts: rebates are paid daily
rebates are calculated per market
maker fee-equivalent uses the fee curve
daily maker rebate equals own fee-equivalent share times rebate pool
sports reference maker rebate pool share on observation date is 0.15
rebate percentage may change over time

sources.name: Gamma market schema
facts: market feeSchedule exposes exponent
market feeSchedule exposes rate
market feeSchedule exposes takerOnly
market feeSchedule exposes rebateRate

sources.name: Builder Fees
facts: builder fees are independent of platform fees
builder fees apply when a builder code is attached
no builder code means no builder fee
